标签标题和脱敏网址会发送到你配置的模型接口；本机代理也可能转发给远程服务。: Tab titles and redacted URLs are sent to your configured model endpoint. Local proxies may forward them to a remote service.
填写服务支持的模型 ID: Enter a model ID supported by your service
使用 OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容协议；填写基础地址，不: Uses the OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible protocol. Enter the base URL without /chat/completions. Remote services require HTTPS; local services can use HTTP. Changing the base URL clears the key. Keys stay on this device and are not synced or exported. Titles and URL paths may still contain sensitive content.
仅发送待整理标签的标题和脱敏网址（域名、路径）。不发送网址账号密码、查询参数、片: Only titles and redacted URLs (domain and path) of eligible tabs are sent. URL credentials, query parameters, fragments, and learning history are not sent. Reusing groups sends names of existing groups containing eligible tabs. Titles and paths may still contain sensitive information. Add work intranet domains to the exclusion list.
忽略私有 IPv4、IPv6 地址、localhost、单标签主机名及 .loc: Ignores private IPv4/IPv6 addresses, localhost, single-label hostnames, and .local / .internal addresses. No DNS lookups are performed. Exclude company public domains manually.
每行一个域名，同时匹配其子域名；也支持逗号分隔。排除仅约束 AI，本地手动分组和: One domain per line, including its subdomains. Comma separation is also supported. Exclusions apply to AI; local manual grouping and rules remain available. All settings and rules stay on this device.
限制 AI 为本次待整理标签生成的分组数量: Limit the number of groups AI creates for this batch of tabs
每个窗口的可参与 AI 整理的未分组标签达到此数量时触发: Trigger when eligible ungrouped tabs in each window reach this count
发送给模型的单个标签标题最大字符数: Maximum characters per tab title sent to the model
每个普通窗口独立计数和冷却，达到阈值后自动分组；冷却期间的新标签会补查，不跨窗口: Each normal window has its own count and cooldown. Tabs are grouped when the threshold is met. Tabs opened during cooldown are checked later; tabs stay in their windows.
只整理未分组标签；建议名称与已有分组相同时直接加入。: Organize only ungrouped tabs. Add them to an existing group when the suggested name matches.
根据域名规则和本机学习记录，把新标签直接加入对应分组，不调用模型。: Use domain rules and local learning records to place new tabs in a group without calling a model.
自动将 Gmail、日历、Slack、Spotify 等固定在标签栏左侧。: Pin apps such as Gmail, Calendar, Slack, and Spotify to the left of the tab bar.
标签跳转到不相关的域名后，自动移出原分组。: Remove a tab from its group when it navigates to an unrelated domain.
记录分组改名和标签移动，手动修正的权重为普通记录的三倍。: Remember group renames and tab moves. Manual corrections carry three times the usual weight.
记住被移除的分组建议，减少重复推荐。: Remember removed grouping suggestions to reduce repeated recommendations.
当组内主题变得分散时，提示需要重新整理。: Flag groups whose topics have become scattered for reorganization.
在本机分析整理历史，记录经常出现在同一组的域名。: Analyze organization history locally to remember domains frequently grouped together.
分组一致性低于此百分比时标记提示: Flag groups when consistency falls below this percentage

仅针对已知定价的估算；不代表服务商的实际额度。0 为不限。: Based only on known prices, not your provider’s actual quota. 0 means unlimited.
仅检查此设置页所在窗口。跳过正在查看、固定、锁定分组、播放音频及加载中的页面。闲: Checks only the window containing this settings page. Skips active, pinned, locked-group, audible, and loading tabs. Adjust the inactivity threshold in Tools.
先归档，再关闭你勾选的标签。归档可重新打开网址，不会保存未提交的表单或页面登录状: Selected tabs are archived before closing. Archives reopen URLs; they do not save unsubmitted forms or page login state. All records stay on this device.
归档不会自动删除。重新打开到当前窗口，并跳过已经打开的相同网址；原有标签不会被移: Archives are not deleted automatically. Reopen into this window, skipping URLs already open. Existing tabs are not moved. Deleting an archive does not close tabs.
新建 AI 分组名称跟随所选语言；已有分组名称保持不变。: New AI group names use the selected language. Existing group names are preserved.
